evd_title: GAR achieved a human-likeness score of 3.89 to 4.02 across three datasets significantly outperforming all LLM baselines
finding: GAR achieved a human-likeness score of 3.89 to 4.02 across three datasets significantly outperforming all LLM baselines
P: 1,000-paper subsets each of NeurIPS 2023, ICLR 2022, ICLR 2023 (OpenReview)
I: GAR reviewer agent (graph-based memory, persona, multi-round refinement), GPT-4o-mini backbone
O: GPT-4o human-likeness (1-5): GAR 3.89-4.02 vs AI-Scientist 3.34-3.39, AI-Review 3.30-3.42, ReviewerGPT 3.25-3.29, OpenReviewer 2.43-2.45
